subject: NovaCorp — Admin seed, API keys & SSO metadata (initial)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NovaCorp — Admin seed, API keys & SSO metadata (initial)

Hi Liam — great to kick this off. Quick checklist to get your initial tenant live on Redwood: 

1) Admin roster: please confirm the initial two admins (name + corporate email) we should seed. These accounts will receive owner-level API keys and console access.
2) SSO: attach IdP metadata (SAML) or OIDC issuer + client_id. If you prefer SCIM user sync later, let us know.
3) Network: any IP ranges to allowlist for outbound traffic to your infra? If you need IP-based egress rules for webhooks, share CSV.
4) Project & role names: recommended default projects: "prod" and "dev"; roles: Admin, Developer, Billing. Tell us if you want changes.
5) API key policy: do you want a single seeded admin key or separate per-admin keys (recommended)?

I attached a short onboarding checklist and a sample CSV for IP allowlist. Proposed next steps: you reply with the admin emails and SSO metadata; Monica will schedule a 45m activation call for this week. If that works, I can seed admin keys once we get IdP metadata.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- nova_onboarding_mvp_checklist.pdf
- ip-allowlist.csv

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nambiar <priya.n@novacorp.com>, NovaCorp Security <security@novacorp.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaCorp — Admin seed, API keys & SSO metadata (initial)

Thanks Soojin — thanks for the clear checklist. Answers below: 

1) Admin roster (seed these two):
- Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacorp.com> (Primary)
- Priya Nambiar <priya.n@novacorp.com> (Backup)

2) SSO: attaching our SAML metadata file (novacorp_sso_metadata.xml). We currently use Okta; we do NOT want SCIM enabled yet.

3) Network: appending our outbound egress ranges in the attached CSV (internal note: we allowlist 3 IP blocks).

4) Projects/roles: Prod and Sandbox are our preferred project names. Roles: Admin / Engineer / Security-Reviewer. Please create those.

5) API key policy: we prefer an admin key per admin. Provide rotation guidance.

Can we schedule the activation call tomorrow 10/31 at 3pm PT? Priya and I can join.

Best,
Liam
Director, Platform Engineering
NovaCorp

Attachments:
- novacorp_sso_metadata.xml
- ip-allowlist.csv

Liam / Soojin — thanks for the quick replies and attachments. 3pm PT tomorrow works for us; I've booked a 45m activation slot and sent a calendar invite (see HubSpot link). Agenda: 
- Confirm admin seed and create accounts (10m)
- Validate SSO metadata + quick SAML test (15m)
- Seed per-admin API keys and show key rotation (10m)
- Project/role creation and minimal policy walkthrough (10m)

Ben, Marissa — please be ready to:
- Create projects: "prod" (prod-novacorp) and "sandbox" (sandbox-novacorp)
- Provision roles: Admin, Engineer, Security-Reviewer
- Seed two admin API keys and drop into secure notes (do not email plaintext keys)

Liam — for the keys, we will ask you to confirm a secure delivery channel (DocuSign/1Password shared vault). If you prefer DocuSign, confirm and I'll attach the link.

Monica
Senior Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
